text_en: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
text_cn: 因为我们知道：如果我们这地上帐棚式的寓所拆毁了，我们必由天主获得一所房舍，一所非人手所造，而永远在天上的寓所。

text_en: For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling—
text_cn: 诚然，我们在此叹息，因为我们切望套上那属天上的住所，

text_en: if indeed, when we have taken it off we will not be found naked.
text_cn: 只要我们还穿着衣服，不是赤裸的。

text_en: For while we are still in this tent, we groan under our burden, because we wish not to be unclothed but to be further clothed, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
text_cn: 我们在这帐棚里的人，苦恼叹息，是由于我们不愿脱去衣服，而就套上另一层，为使这有死的为生命所吸收。

text_en: He who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a guarantee.
text_cn: 但那安排我们如此的，是天主，是他给我们赐下了圣神作抵押。

text_en: So we are always confident; even though we know that while we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord—
text_cn: 所以不论怎样，我们时常放心大胆，因为我们知道，我们几时住在这肉身内，就是与主远离──

text_en: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
text_cn: 因为我们现今只是凭信德往来，并非凭目睹──

text_en: Yes, we do have confidence, and we would rather be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
text_cn: 我们放心大胆，是为更情愿出离肉身，与主同住。

text_en: So whether we are at home or away, we make it our aim to please him.
text_cn: 为此我们或住在或出离肉身，常专心以讨主的喜悦为光荣。

text_en: For all of us must appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each may receive recompense for what has been done in the body, whether good or evil.
text_cn: 因为我们众人都应出现在基督的审判台前，为使各人藉他肉身所行的，或善或恶，领取相当的报应。

text_en: Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we try to persuade others; but we ourselves are well known to God, and I hope that we are also well known to your consciences.
text_cn: 我们既然知道主的可畏，遂尽力使人相信我们；我们在主前是显明的，我也盼望在你们的良心前也是显明的。

text_en: We are not commending ourselves to you again, but giving you an opportunity to boast about us, so that you may be able to answer those who boast in outward appearance and not in the heart.
text_cn: 这并不是我们又向你们举荐自己，而是为给你们一个有为我们夸耀的机会，使你们有以对付那些只凭外貌，而不凭内心夸耀的人们，

text_en: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.
text_cn: 因为如果说我们是发狂，那是为了天主；如果说我们是清醒，那是为了你们。

text_en: For the love of Christ urges us on, because we are convinced that one has died for all; therefore all have died.
text_cn: 因为基督的爱催迫着我们，因我们曾如此断定：既然一个人替众人死了，那么众人就都死了；

text_en: And he died for all, so that those who live might live no longer for themselves, but for him who died and was raised for them.
text_cn: 他替众人死，是为使活着的人不再为自己生活，而是为替他们死而复活了的那位生活。

text_en: From now on, therefore, we regard no one from a human point of view; even though we once knew Christ from a human point of view, we know him no longer in that way.
text_cn: 所以我们从今以后，不再按人的看法认识谁了；纵使我们曾按人的看法认识过基督，但如今不再这样认识他了。

text_en: So if anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation: everything old has passed away; see, everything has become new!
text_cn: 所以谁若在基督内，他就是一个新受造物，旧的已成过去，看，都成了新的。

text_en: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ, and has given us the ministry of reconciliation;
text_cn: 这一切都是出于天主，他曾藉基督使我们与他自己和好，并将这和好的职务赐给了我们：

text_en: that is, in Christ God was reconciling the world to himself, not counting their trespasses against them, and entrusting the message of reconciliation to us.
text_cn: 这就是说：天主在基督内使世界与自己和好，不再追究他们的过犯，且将和好的话放在我们的口中。

text_en: So we are ambassadors for Christ, since God is making his appeal through us; we entreat you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
text_cn: 所以我们是代基督作大使了，好像是天主藉着我们来劝勉世人。我们如今代基督请求你们：与天主和好罢！

text_en: For our sake he made him to be sin who knew no sin, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
text_cn: 因为他曾使那不认识罪的，替我们成了罪，好叫我们在他内成为天主的正义。
